intro: Foreman Oslow directs adventurers into the Rethban Caverns of Redridge to retrieve a peculiar dark mineral. While too soft to forge reliable armor or weapons, its unique pigmentation makes it indispensable to the scribes of Northshire Abbey for crafting specialized ink.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban. When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes. It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

We usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any. And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.
So if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the Rethban Ore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, splendid! I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.
